newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Nicaragua police foil alleged attack on new leader.
newsitem.headline: Nicaragua police foil alleged attack on new leader.

text.p: Nicaraguan police on Friday arrested two men carrying dynamite they said they planned to use in an attack on newly inaugurated President Arnoldo Aleman, a police spokesman said.
"We have arrested two men, one of whom has been identified as a retired police officer, who were carrying dynamite ready to explode," police spokesman Capt. Justo Zamora told Reuters.
Zamora said the men were arrested in the capital Managua and confessed they were going to use the dynamite against Aleman.
Zamora said a news conference had been scheduled later Friday on the incident.

Aleman, a right-winger, was inaugurated on Friday as president in a ceremony in Managua's Rigoberto Lopez Perez stadium. The event, which passed without disturbances, was boycotted by Aleman's political enemies, the leaders of the leftist Sandinista Front.
